detail: JWT payload carries a custom sid claim pointing at a row in the sessions table — the thread that links stateless JWTs back to the stateful session.
refresh_tokens.session_id is a FOREIGN KEY into sessions; refresh rejects if the session is revoked.
The refresh endpoint mints a new 15-minute JWT bound to the same session_id.
Logout sets revoked_at = now() on the sessions row.
Logout deletes every refresh_tokens row bound to the session_id in the same atomic transaction.
Short 15-minute JWT TTL implies clients must refresh via /auth/refresh rather than re-posting credentials.
